components.css: .ds-verification-strip { padding: 14px 16px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6e0e8); border-radius: var(--radius, 5px); color: var(--ink, #1d3143); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel, 0 2px 7px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 4%)); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-verification-strip h2 { margin: 0; color: #1b3043; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-verification-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; margin: 13px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-verification-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 17px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 2px 14px 2px 0; } .ds-verification-step + .ds-verification-step { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid #dce5eb; } .ds-step-symbol { display: block; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-top: 3px; border: 1px solid #a9b8c3; border-radius: 50%; background: #f1f4f6; } .ds-observed .ds-step-symbol { border-color: #4c7896; background: #dcebf4; } .ds-approved .ds-step-symbol { border-color: #8b741f; background: #f5df8d; } .ds-verified .ds-step-symbol { border-color: #317654; background: #a8d4ba; } .ds-step-content { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-step-content strong { color: #31495d; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-content span { color: var(--muted, #586c7e); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-verified .ds-step-content strong, .ds-verified .ds-step-content span { color: #246244; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-verification-strip { padding: 12px; } .ds-verification-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-verification-step, .ds-verification-step + .ds-verification-step { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px; border-left: 0; } .ds-verification-step + .ds-verification-step { border-top: 1px solid #e5ebef; } }

narrative.overview:
Centralign uses a compact work interface to make actions, proposed writes and checked results inspectable. Pale blue-white fields separate evidence from the navy navigation. Yellow draws attention to approval; green identifies a verified result. Normal browser controls keep tasks familiar.

The system comes from `public/dashboard.css`, `public/index.html`, `public/company.css` and `public/company.html`. `PRODUCT.md` supplies the evidence and synthetic-data constraints; `.impeccable/surfaces/public-index-html.md` records the approved direction. This is code-led documentation, not a comp-fidelity claim or a browser-QA verdict.
keyCharacteristics: Compact panels with readable evidence and explicit state labels.
Native controls, keyboard focus and recoverable errors.
Synthetic records clearly distinguished from real execution evidence.

rules.name: The state color rule
rules.body: Yellow means a human checkpoint, green means a checked result, and red means a failed or cancelled state. Pair color with explicit text.

rules.name: The readable evidence rule
rules.body: Event messages and inspection details must be at least 12px; keep metadata readable at normal zoom. Do not standardize the smaller pre-review event styles as design tokens.

dos: Do keep all navigation destinations visible on narrow screens.
Do make event text, metadata, approval details and full-size captures readable and inspectable.
Do label synthetic business data and distinguish observations from verified results.
Do preserve native semantics, visible keyboard focus and explicit state text.
donts: Don't add marketing heroes, decorative metrics, ornamental imagery or new fonts.
Don't mark a result verified because the model says it is complete.
Don't hide evidence behind clipped text, low contrast or a scaled screenshot alone.
Don't treat this code-led reference as proof of visual fidelity or completed capture QA.
